items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Did you know Ricky Tom or Tom Ricky? Tom Ricky. Yeah. Tom Ricky. Now he traveled didn't he huh?

ctx.x: Well no at that time I think Tom Brown had already left and he came to New York. Tom Brown was a flop. In the words of music. You've got bands leaving New Orleans right now. You've got bands that have left here before. You've got bands like the Dukes that are doing wonderful but you've had bands before without mentioning there. They've been flops. Yeah. Yeah. It's the same thing.
Did you know Ricky Tom or Tom Ricky? Tom Ricky. Yeah. Tom Ricky. Now he traveled didn't he huh?
Uh Tom? Yeah. I don't know. I don't know if Tom traveled.
